Stock market news | Zydus Lifesciences sets up wholly owned subsidiary in Australia

Zydus Lifesciences has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in Australia. The update was shared by the company in a regulatory filing on 25 November 2026.

According to the regulatory filing, the newly incorporated entity currently has nil turnover and is yet to begin operations.
